subject: math
description: Complete a cumulative geometry construction task by creating a map with parallel and perpendicular roads, labeling angle relationships, solving measures, and organizing reasoning.
learningObjectives: Create a geometric map using parallel and perpendicular roads
Use notation to label lines, segments, angles, and intersections accurately
Identify angle relationships formed by parallel lines, perpendicular lines, and transversals
Solve missing angle measures using vertical angles, linear pairs, supplementary angles, and parallel-line angle theorems
Write organized reasoning that connects each answer to a geometric relationship
prerequisites: Name points, lines, segments, rays, and angles using correct notation
Construct segments, angles, perpendicular lines, and parallel lines with tools
Identify vertical, adjacent, linear pair, supplementary, corresponding, alternate interior, alternate exterior, and same-side interior angles
